one_liner: Waterfall.io offers a REST API for contact and company enrichment that uses an x-api-key header. Keys are issued only after the vendor approves a request, and pricing is quoted case by case.
auth_notes: A static API key goes in the x-api-key header. A master key can create sub-keys. Webhooks are signed with Ed25519 keys fetched through a JWKS endpoint.
access_notes: Access is by approval. You enter a work email or book a call, and the team reviews every request. Pricing is quoted after a benchmark. No free tier or self-serve trial is documented.
blocker_notes: Keys are issued only after approval and a conversation with the team. Some endpoints are in preview or need access enabled on the key. The draft's MCP evidence was for WP Waterfall, a different company, so I removed it. None of the Waterfall.io pages I was given mention an MCP server, only agent skills. The mcp value 'none' is kept at low confidence.

evidence.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header.
API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/) to request a key
A member of our team reviews every access request.
Per-credit rates depend on the endpoints you use and the volume you commit to, and are quoted after a benchmark on a sample of your own records
The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header.
